ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Mars

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between conversations and routine. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between money and romance. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your image and family. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between friendships and money. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your career and your image. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up home and family.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your career. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Until {H:1811243096000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between family and relationships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.
